findings.issue: firstObserved timing was scoped to date+session, causing a ticker observed in pre-market to receive a new firstObserved timestamp when regular trading began. This can overstate detection latency and corrupt Discovery/Ignition/Late attribution.
findings.action: Changed firstObserved to preserve the earliest observation across the full trading date while also storing separate session-specific first-observation fields.
